component.name: DonutTaskManager
component.summary: System process manager and performance monitor

description.p: DonutTaskManager is a lightweight system monitor for Linux, built with GTK4 and libadwaita. It lists running processes grouped by application, and graphs CPU, memory, disk, network and GPU use.

You can end, force kill and reprioritize processes, manage startup entries and systemd services, and restart desktop environment components. A warning dialog stops you from killing critical system processes by accident. Ctrl+Shift+Esc can be registered as a global shortcut from the app.
